final: WITH side_counts AS (SELECT o.dealedge, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM riskandmargin r JOIN orders o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.dealedge), side_average AS (SELECT AVG(order_count) AS avg_count FROM side_counts) SELECT SUM(order_count) AS total_count, AVG(order_count - avg_count) AS average_excess FROM side_counts CROSS JOIN side_average WHERE order_count > avg_count
